blocks.source_text: IS THIS WHERE YOU'RE GONNA SPEND TIME DITCHING WORK TODAY?
blocks.translation: Hôm nay cậu định trốn việc ở đây à?
blocks.notes: Visible male speaker; no canonical speaker ID.

blocks.source_text: THE BOSS LADY TOLD ME TO FEED THE DOG. ARE YOU DONE WITH YOUR WORK?
blocks.translation: Bà chủ bảo tôi đi cho chó ăn. Cậu làm xong việc chưa?
blocks.notes: Same conversation; exact relationship/title not canonicalized.

blocks.source_text: NAH. I JUST LEFT 'CAUSE I GOT TIRED.
blocks.translation: Chưa. Tôi bỏ ra đây vì mệt quá thôi.
blocks.notes: Reply from the other visible male character.

blocks.source_text: YOU LITTLE PUNK... ARE YOU SICK WITH THE VIRUS THAT CAUSES "CID?"
blocks.translation: Thằng nhóc này... cậu mắc cái virus gây ra "CID" à?
blocks.notes: CID is preserved verbatim because smoke context has no canonical terminology.

blocks.source_text: YOU'RE GONNA GET ON THE BOSS LADY'S BAD SIDE.
blocks.translation: Cậu sẽ chọc giận bà chủ đấy.

blocks.source_text: THE BOSS BITCH? SHE LETS ME OFF THE HOOK WHEN I SAY...
blocks.translation: Con mụ sếp ấy hả? Chỉ cần tôi nói thế này là bà ta bỏ qua ngay...
blocks.notes: Preserves the insulting tone of the source.
Source intentionally uses childish/mispronounced speech; Vietnamese mirrors that register.
